name: KrispCall
summary: Virtual numbers across 100+ countries with a shared dashboard, dialer and CRM hooks, priced per user. Calls and SMS are pay-as-you-go from a separate credit balance, so compare per-country call rates at your volume rather than the seat price.
best_for: sales and support teams that need virtual numbers across many countries with a shared dashboard, dialer and CRM hooks at a budget seat price
skip_if: your calling is domestic-only at low volume (simpler tools suffice), or you need enterprise reliability guarantees over price
honest_knock: Same honest math as most budget VoIP: the plan buys the platform, the meter buys the conversations — per-minute and per-SMS charges land on top of every seat, so the comparison that matters is call-rate-per-country at your volume. The 100+ country number coverage is genuinely the draw; verify number availability and local regulations for your specific target countries before committing.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month billed annually, or $15 monthly (up to 5 users)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 against the vendor's own pricing page) Essential $12 per user/mo billed annually or $15 monthly, for solo agents and teams up to 5 people; Standard $32 per user/mo annually or $40 monthly, for teams scaling up to 50 users; Enterprise custom. Annual saves 20%, which the page puts at $36 per user a year on Essential and $96 on Standard, and each plan comes with $1 of free calling and SMS credit. Calls and SMS are otherwise pay-as-you-go from a separate credit balance, and numbers carry their own one-off and monthly charges (from $4.50 one-off and $1.50 a month at the time of reading).
